scripts.frontend: sh -c 'set -a; [ -f .env ] && . ./.env; set +a; exec pnpm --dir frontend dev -- --host 0.0.0.0 --port ${FRONTEND_PORT:-5173}'
scripts.backend: sh -c 'set -a; [ -f .env ] && . ./.env; set +a; cd backend && . venv/bin/activate && exec uvicorn app.main:app --reload --host 0.0.0.0 --port ${BACKEND_PORT:-8000}'
scripts.dev: sh -c 'trap "kill 0" EXIT INT TERM; pnpm run backend & pnpm run frontend & wait'
